subject: general
question: Who among the following social reformers founded an educational institution, Hindu Widows Home, in Poona in the year 1896?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhondo Keshav Karve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhondo Keshav Karve** was an Indian social reformer and teacher, known for supporting women's education and organizing associations for the remarriage of Hindu widows.

 
 
• **Karve founded (1896) the Hindu Widows Home, an educational institution in Poona, to help widows who could not remarry**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Puli Thevar** was a Tamil polygamer who ruled Neerkattumseval located in Sankarankoil taluk, Tenkasi, Tamil Nadu.

 
 
• He is fighting a remarkable battle against the East India Company in India in 1759 - 1761.
 
• Ondiviran and Venni Kaladi were the commanders of Thevar's army to fight against the East India Company.
 
 
 
• **Chandikadas Amritrao Deshmukh**, better known as **Nanaji Deshmukh**, was a social reformer and politician from India.
 
 
• He worked in the field of education, health, and rural self-reliance.
 
• He was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 2019 by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Tantia Tope** was a general in the **Indian Rebellion of 1857** and one of its notable leaders.
 
 
• Tantia Tope defeated the Indian troops of the East India Company at Kanpur in **May 1857**.
 
• He led the Indians in the Revolt of 1857 and was noted for his guerrilla tactics, which intimidated the British.
 
• General Wyndham was forced by them to leave the city of Gwalior.
 
• **Sir Colin Campbell (later Baron Clyde)** defeated Tantia Tope on December 6, 1857.
